d.ko: You've been exiled to The Mirk - an unforgiving swampland where every step could be your last. You must constantly make choices: what paths to take, which tree to shelter under, what beasts to engage or avoid, what items to bring into the darkness of dungeons, and what treasures to leave behind.

d.zh: 你被流放到了幽沼（The Mirk），这是一片冷酷无情的沼泽之地，在这里，每一步都可能是你的最后一步。你必须不断做出抉择：走哪条路，躲在哪棵树下，该招惹哪些野兽、该避开哪些野兽，带什么物品深入黑暗地牢，又要把什么财宝留在身后……
